Now I see the map clearly. The '@' is at (2,7). There's no 'o' at (2,7) — the notice board isn't shown as 'o' on the map. The 'o' objects are at (7,6) [Gold Door] and (10,5) [workbench].

So the notice board at (2,7) is NOT shown as a blocking 'o' on the map — it's under '@'. This means the notice board might be a "readable" that doesn't actually block the tile, OR the map just doesn't render it.

But raw input is blocked in all directions. So something IS blocking me. The pathfinder said "Notice Board at (2,7)".

Wait — maybe the notice board is at (2,7) and it's a solid object, but the map renders '@' over it. The tile is blocked.

Let me reconsider: maybe I'm NOT actually at (2,7). Maybe the observe is reporting my position wrong, or maybe the notice board is at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7) but the game considers me "on" it.

Let me try a totally different approach: maybe the notice board is read by pressing E while facing it, and the board is at (2,7) but its "read" is triggered when I face it from an adjacent tile. Since I can't move, let me try pressing E while facing UP (toward (2,6)) — maybe the board is actually at (2,6) and I'm at (2,7). But observe said board at (2,7).

Hmm, let me try pressing E while facing UP and see if it reads a notice at (2,6).
